hard_documented_breaches.title: Give the independently owned map-pick gate its own module

rule.quote: 一个组件/类/模块一个文件

hard_documented_breaches.trigger: The changed file exports MapPickGate at line 57 and MapDrawingController at line 87. MapPickGate belongs to the viewport lifetime rather than controller disposal.
hard_documented_breaches.required_change: Move MapPickGate unchanged to apps/planner/src/data/MapPickGate.ts and update its direct test import. Preserve behavior; no larger refactor is needed.
hard_documented_breaches.reproduction: probe.py reads the fixed Git object and current root rule; probe.json.exported_classes_in_controller_file records both declarations.
hard_documented_breaches.scope: Documented organization rule only, not a runtime defect or Fowler file-length finding.

verification_boundary: Full fixed Standards diff only; no source changes or source copies, new dependencies/worktrees/stacks/network, native/GPU/touch execution, provider permission, production, engineering or full-goal acceptance.
